client/.github/scripts/sign-macos-app.sh.after_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

app_path=$1
identity=$2
entitlements=$3

# ArceusTech packaging fix: ad-hoc has no Apple Team ID for library validation.
# Developer ID builds retain hardened runtime and timestamp.
sign_args=(--force --options 0 --sign "$identity")
if [[ "$identity" != "-" ]]; then
  sign_args+=(--options runtime --timestamp)
fi

frameworks_path="$app_path/Contents/Frameworks"
if [[ -d "$frameworks_path" ]]; then
  while IFS= read -r -d '' code; do
    if file -b "$code" | grep -q 'Mach-O'; then
      codesign "${sign_args[@]}" "$code"
    fi
  done < <(find "$frameworks_path" -type f -print0)

  while IFS= read -r -d '' framework; do
    codesign "${sign_args[@]}" "$framework"
  done < <(find "$frameworks_path" -depth -type d -name '*.framework' -print0)
fi

service_path="$app_path/Contents/MacOS/service"
if [[ -f "$service_path" ]]; then
  codesign "${sign_args[@]}" "$service_path"
fi

codesign "${sign_args[@]}" --generate-entitlement-der \
  --entitlements "$entitlements" "$app_path"
codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$app_path"

actual_entitlements=$(codesign -d --entitlements :- "$app_path" 2>/dev/null)
audio_input=$(plutil -extract 'com\.apple\.security\.device\.audio-input' raw - \
  <<<"$actual_entitlements")
if [[ "$audio_input" != "true" ]]; then
  echo "Missing com.apple.security.device.audio-input entitlement" >&2
  exit 1
fi

scripts/build-macos.sh.after_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Modified distribution, AGPL-3.0-only. Native macOS build; no service installation.
set -euo pipefail
export PYTHONUTF8=1
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
if [[ "$(uname -s)" != Darwin ]]; then echo 'Run on macOS with Xcode installed' >&2; exit 1; fi
case "${1:-}" in
  --skip-configure) ;;
  --unconfigured) python3 scripts/configure.py --unconfigured --role "${2:-customer}" ;;
  *) python3 scripts/configure.py --env "${1:-config/client.env}" ;;
esac
: "${VCPKG_ROOT:?Set VCPKG_ROOT to the pinned vcpkg checkout}"
FLUTTER_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$(command -v flutter)")/.." && pwd)"
NAME="$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("config/public-build.json"))["APP_NAME"])')"
BINARY="$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("config/public-build.json"))["BINARY_NAME"])')"
ARCH="$(uname -m)"
FEATURES='flutter,custom-support,unix-file-copy-paste'
case "$ARCH" in
  arm64) TARGET=aarch64-apple-darwin; TRIPLET=arm64-osx; FEATURES+=,screencapturekit ;;
  x86_64) TARGET=x86_64-apple-darwin; TRIPLET=x64-osx ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
# One conservative deployment baseline on both architectures. ARM uses upstream ScreenCaptureKit.
export MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.3
export FLUTTER_XCODE_ARCHS="$ARCH" FLUTTER_XCODE_ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES
export FLUTTER_XCODE_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- FLUTTER_XCODE_CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=YES
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('client/flutter/macos/Podfile')
p.write_text(re.sub(r"platform :osx, '[^']+'", "platform :osx, '12.3'", p.read_text()))
p=Path('client/flutter/macos/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj')
p.write_text(re.sub(r'MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = [0-9.]+;', 'MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 12.3;', p.read_text()))
PY
test -s client/flutter/macos/Runner/bridge_generated.h
(cd client/flutter && flutter pub get && cd macos && pod install)
# Server metadata needs edition 2024 support; the client compiler stays pinned.
rustup toolchain install 1.85.1 --profile minimal --no-self-update
python3 scripts/collect_licenses.py --vcpkg "$VCPKG_ROOT" --flutter "$FLUTTER_ROOT" --target "$TARGET" --triplet "$TRIPLET"
(cd client && cargo build --locked --release --lib --features "$FEATURES")
cp client/target/release/liblibrustdesk.dylib client/target/release/librustdesk.dylib
(cd client/flutter && flutter analyze --no-pub --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings lib/desktop/support lib/common.dart lib/desktop/pages/connection_page.dart lib/desktop/widgets/remote_toolbar.dart && flutter build macos --release)
APP="client/flutter/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/$NAME.app"
test -x "$APP/Contents/MacOS/$NAME"
mkdir -p "$APP/Contents/Resources/OpenSource"
cp LICENSE README_INSTALL.md "$APP/Contents/Resources/OpenSource/"
cp -R source-offer "$APP/Contents/Resources/OpenSource/"
cp config/public-build.json "$APP/Contents/Resources/build-info.json"
# Ad-hoc signing is needed for Apple Silicon; it is NOT Developer ID or notarization.
bash scripts/sign-macos.sh "$APP"
"$APP/Contents/MacOS/$NAME" --version
mkdir -p dist
STAGING="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/arceustech-dmg.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$STAGING"' EXIT
ditto "$APP" "$STAGING/$NAME.app"
ln -s /Applications "$STAGING/Applications"
cp README_INSTALL.md LICENSE "$STAGING/"
DMG="dist/$BINARY-macOS-$ARCH.dmg"
hdiutil create -volname "$NAME" -srcfolder "$STAGING" -format UDZO -ov "$DMG"
if [[ -n "${APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY:-}" ]]; then
  codesign --force --timestamp --sign "$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY" "$DMG"
fi
if [[ -n "${APPLE_NOTARY_PROFILE:-}" ]]; then
  : "${APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY:?Notarization requires a Developer ID identity}"
  xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG" --keychain-profile "$APPLE_NOTARY_PROFILE" --wait
  xcrun stapler staple "$DMG"
  xcrun stapler validate "$DMG"
fi
# ditto preserves links, permissions and extended attributes of the .app.
ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "$APP" "dist/$BINARY-macOS-$ARCH.app.zip"
python3 scripts/package_source.py --with-deps --output "dist/$BINARY-macOS-$ARCH-source.tar.gz"
(cd dist && shasum -a 256 ./*.dmg ./*.zip ./*.tar.gz > SHA256SUMS.txt)
echo 'Artifacts ready for internal review. Native launch, permissions and cross-platform E2E still require validation.'

scripts/build-windows.ps1.after_content:
param([string]$ConfigurationFile = 'config/client.env', [switch]$SkipConfigure, [switch]$Unconfigured, [ValidateSet('customer','operator')][string]$Role = 'customer')
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$env:PYTHONUTF8 = '1'
$Root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
Set-Location $Root
function Check-Exit([string]$Step) { if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "$Step failed ($LASTEXITCODE)" } }
if (-not $SkipConfigure) {
    if ($Unconfigured) { python scripts/configure.py --unconfigured --role $Role }
    else { python scripts/configure.py --env $ConfigurationFile }
    Check-Exit 'Public configuration'
}
$Config = Get-Content config/public-build.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$Name = $Config.BINARY_NAME
if (-not $env:VCPKG_ROOT) { throw 'Set VCPKG_ROOT' }
$FlutterRoot = Split-Path (Split-Path (Get-Command flutter).Source -Parent) -Parent
if (-not (Test-Path client/src/bridge_generated.rs)) { throw 'Generate Flutter/Rust bridge first; see README_BUILD.md' }
Push-Location client/flutter
flutter pub get; Check-Exit 'flutter pub get'
Pop-Location
# Server source inventory uses Cargo with lockfile v4 / edition 2024 support.
rustup toolchain install 1.85.1 --profile minimal --no-self-update; Check-Exit 'Server inventory toolchain'
python scripts/collect_licenses.py --vcpkg $env:VCPKG_ROOT --flutter $FlutterRoot; Check-Exit 'Dependency inventory'
Push-Location client
cargo build --locked --release --lib --features flutter,custom-support; Check-Exit 'Rust compilation'
Pop-Location
Push-Location client/flutter
flutter analyze --no-pub --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings lib/desktop/support lib/common.dart lib/desktop/pages/connection_page.dart lib/desktop/widgets/remote_toolbar.dart; Check-Exit 'Support UI analysis'
flutter build windows --release; Check-Exit 'Flutter Windows compilation'
Pop-Location
$Release = Join-Path $Root 'client/flutter/build/windows/x64/runner/Release'
foreach ($File in @('rustdesk.exe','librustdesk.dll','flutter_windows.dll')) {
    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Release $File))) { throw "Missing output $File" }
}
$Bundle = Join-Path $Root 'dist/bundle'
if (Test-Path $Bundle) { Remove-Item $Bundle -Recurse -Force }
New-Item $Bundle -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item "$Release/*" $Bundle -Recurse
$VirtualDisplay = 'client/target/release/deps/dylib_virtual_display.dll'
if (Test-Path $VirtualDisplay) { Copy-Item $VirtualDisplay $Bundle }
Rename-Item (Join-Path $Bundle 'rustdesk.exe') "$Name.exe"
Copy-Item LICENSE $Bundle
Copy-Item source-offer "$Bundle/source-offer" -Recurse
Copy-Item README_INSTALL.md $Bundle
@{ app=$Name; source_url=$Config.SOURCE_URL; role=$Config.ROLE; upstream=(Get-Content upstream-lock.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json); status='INTERNAL BUILD - E2E NOT YET VERIFIED' } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content "$Bundle/build-info.json"
foreach ($File in (Get-ChildItem $Bundle -Filter *.dll)) { & "$PSScriptRoot/sign.ps1" -Path $File.FullName }
& "$PSScriptRoot/sign.ps1" -Path "$Bundle/$Name.exe"
$Smoke = Start-Process -FilePath "$Bundle/$Name.exe" -ArgumentList '--version' -Wait -PassThru
if ($Smoke.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Native version smoke failed ($($Smoke.ExitCode))" }
$ISCC = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path $ISCC)) { throw 'Install Inno Setup 6' }
& $ISCC installer/setup.iss; Check-Exit 'Installer compilation'
& "$PSScriptRoot/sign.ps1" -Path "dist/$Name-Setup.exe"
Compress-Archive -Path "$Bundle/*" -DestinationPath "dist/$Name-Windows-x64.zip" -Force
python scripts/package_source.py --with-deps --output "dist/$Name-Windows-x64-source.tar.gz"; Check-Exit 'Corresponding source archive'
Get-ChildItem dist -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.exe','.zip','.gz' } | Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Hash.ToLower())  $(Split-Path $_.Path -Leaf)" } | Set-Content dist/SHA256SUMS.txt
Write-Host 'Build staged. Public distribution still requires license review and authorized E2E results.'
